checks.fidelity_ex_wild_cantor: AUDIT-1 major 1 is fixed. Antoine's necklace is BUILT (antoineNecklace = stereographic image of ⋂ₙ antoineStage n) and proved a Cantor set sorry-free. The row's theorem antoineNecklace_wild_not_isSLSCInCC is about this set; the existential forms are corollaries. I checked the geometry by hand. A type-0 ring centred at (a,−560)/640 and the type-1 ring centred at (a+70,−560)/640 (in the plane y = const) cross the plane z = 0 at x−a ∈ [14,28] ∪ [112,126] (units 1/640). The first crossing lies in the hole of the horizontal ring (max < 42) and the second is outside it, so the cores have linking number ±1 and consecutive links are genuinely linked. The cyclic closure (i = 63 → 0) is also adjacent. The 64 centres follow the core square of L, so the chain goes around L. Stage-(n+1) links lie in the interior of their stage-n link (radial [504,616] ⊂ (480,640), |z| ≤ 56 < 80). So this is a genuine Antoine necklace, and the sorry'd statement GX.antoineNecklace_antoine is TRUE. The meridian of a sibling link L' is essential in S³ ∖ (C ∩ L') by Antoine's theorem. Every point is accessible through the nested gaps, since ∂L_x(m) ⊆ Cᶜ. Wildness is classical. Neither hypothesis of the criterion is vacuous. IsWildCantor (no homeomorphism of S³ carries C into a great circle) is the standard non-tameness. The paper's hypothesis 'wild' is proved as a conjunct, which is stronger.
checks.sorry_assessment: The one sorry is Antoine's theorem (a cited result, DEC-23), tagged SORRY(ex:wild_cantor_general_antoine) with a precise obstruction. The obstruction analysis is mathematically correct. The meridian of L is null-homologous in the complement of every finite stage, because each small link's core is null-homotopic in L. So linking numbers and abelian covers cannot detect it (and H̃₁(S³∖C) ≅ Ȟ¹(C) = 0). An essential-loop proof needs a non-abelian invariant for every finite stage, inductively, or van Kampen, and neither is in mathlib at this pin. I judge this a genuine obstruction after a serious attempt: the necklace, nesting, disjointness, Cantor coding, criterion reduction and S³ small-loop lemma are all built. The row is honestly 'stated' and unmarked.

issues.problem: The one sorry bundles three facts: (1) the essential meridian, the genuine non-abelian obstruction; (2) accessibility of every point of C by a path meeting C only at its start; (3) wildness. Fact (2) is elementary, an infinite concatenation of paths through the nested gaps L_x(m) ∖ ⋃ stage-(m+1) links with diameters → 0, and it is not van Kampen-type. So the residual is larger than the genuine obstruction. The row's main claim (¬SLSC) needs only (1)+(2), yet it depends on the same sorry as wildness.
